messages.text: Plant controller needs one defensible decision for omitted maintenance labor by 2026-01-17; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside technician, asset, maintenance order, rate, timecard, and period.
I found 782.0 USD on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0095 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000095 up to 8.5 HR, provided technician, asset, maintenance order, rate, timecard, and period. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or defer_current_period_charge.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for final cost-posting window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-096 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-095.

Required closeout records: post the decided option, date, constraint, alternatives, and Oracle reference in the existing operations thread; and add the resulting Oracle reference, option, date, and constraint as a comment on the existing case file. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
